capabilities: Lock the vault workspace behind a password set per device
Lock automatically when the OS signals a screen lock on desktop
Lock after a configurable background grace period on mobile
Trigger locking manually with a Lock now command
Reset a forgotten password verifier via the developer console
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.15.0 or later. README explicitly warns it is only a privacy screen: notes remain readable on disk and the plugin can be disabled from Settings or bypassed via Restricted Mode. Desktop screen-lock detection and mobile lifecycle behavior are still awaiting device verification; manual Lock now is the reliable fallback.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to lock the workspace with a password when you step away from a shared or public device.
summary: Password lock screen for the vault workspace that engages on system screen lock or when Obsidian loses focus.
